title: Complete SKY130 NFET regulator with one reference, damped gate driver and output bleeder
evidence_class: Native ngspice 47 complete tied reference regulator experiments. All included circuit waveforms and curves are native runs.
boundaries: VAA is an independent external ideal 1.8 V source. The common VREF source is external and ideal.
Pass body is tied to its source. Isolated well layout and extraction remain outside this circuit simulation.
Voltage injection results are diagnostic estimates until the port conditions are established.
